species.name: Bat
mustRead: skin membrane stretched between enormously elongated finger bones
large ears on a small furry body
membrane also spanning the hind legs and tail
species.note: Generic name read as a representative insectivorous microbat. The wing is a hand, so the finger struts must fan visibly through the membrane; feathered or leathery bird wings are wrong.

species.name: Insect-Eating Bat
mustRead: membrane wings stretched over elongated finger bones
large upright ears with a spike tragus
species.note: Interpreted as a generic vespertilionid microbat. Wing membrane runs to the ankles and encloses the tail; it is not a feathered or bird-like wing.

species.name: Vampire Bat
mustRead: flat pig-like nose pad with no leaf
large pointed ears and a short conical muzzle
long thumbs used to walk on folded wrists
species.note: Has almost no tail and a very short snout; the fangs are small front incisors, not long protruding canines.
